messages:
maria (Docs): quick heads up — opened PR to tidy dedicated provisioning doc. fixes: SLA table reformat, clarify preemption vs eviction wording, update python SDK snippet, and a couple link fixes. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234>
kevin (Eng): looking now. what changed in the SDK snippet?
maria (Docs): old snippet used `create_capacity(...)` which is outdated. new call is `client.dedicated.provision_tenant(...)`. also showing `autoscale_policy={'cooldown_s': 300}` example so folks know cooldown unit.
sam (Platform): add a short note that reserved pools should set `isolation: true` and a pool selector, otherwise scheduler may place on shared nodes. I can drop a one-liner.
alyssa (PM): should SLA phrasing say 99.95 or 99.9 for Dedicated? we originally promised 99.9 in contract template.
maria (Docs): good catch — contract templates use 99.9. switched table to 99.9 and added footnote: "burst capacity is best-effort; SLA covers reserved pool availability".
kevin (Eng): tiny lint: code block should be `python` and use context manager for client. suggest replacing snippet with:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
with RedwoodClient() as client:
    resp = client.dedicated.provision_tenant(
        tenant_id="acme",
        pool_name="reserved-a100",
        autoscale_policy={"min_replicas":1, "max_replicas":4, "cooldown_s":300},
        isolation=True,
    )
    print(resp.id)
```
maria (Docs): thanks — updated snippet and fixed the two broken internal links. also added a TODO to mention quantized images in the infra notes.
docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #1234 — 3 links flagged (1 external).
sam (Platform): infra nit: also call out GPU selector: recommend `nvidia-a100` for quantized half-fp models; otherwise autoscaler may pick general-purpose nodes and you'll see preemption.
kevin (Eng): ran the snippet locally, works. left a small inline suggestion on the PR to use `pool_label` vs `pool_name` naming (consolidation).
maria (Docs): addressed kevin's suggestion, updated wording to `pool_label` and pushed. thanks for the reviews! :tada: I'll merge after CI passes.
kevin (Eng): LGTM, approve on my end.
alyssa (PM): thx all — file a quick note under handbook changes so ops knows the SLA wording update.
maria (Docs): done — added entry to docs changelog and handbook link. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
